articles.title: Philadelphia's Academy Museum Closes Despite Offer of Temporary Funding
articles.summary: Drexel cited rising costs and falling attendance as Philadelphia's Academy museum closed. A funding offer and planned city hearings could help explore solutions.

articles.title: Federal Judge Temporarily Blocks Border Wall Work in Texas' Big Bend
articles.summary: A court temporarily blocked border wall construction across the Big Bend border sector. Opponents challenge the government's use of waivers to bypass environmental and cultural protection rules.

articles.title: Ohio Truck Factory Layoffs Put Jobs in Focus Before Election
articles.summary: Nearly 1,400 layoffs at an Ohio truck factory put jobs and family budgets in focus before November's election. The Dayton area has also seen growth tied to an expanding air force base.
